Invitation to Tender: Crew Boat Hire for Bonny Terminal
Client: Gulf Energy Ltd
Submission deadline: 2027-03-31
Contract period: 12 months with an option of 6 months

Section 4 - Technical requirements
1. The vessel shall be a crew boat of at least 30 m length, not older than 15 years.
2. Bidders must provide a copy of a valid hull and machinery insurance policy.
3. Bidders must provide a valid class certificate issued by an IACS member.
4. Provide evidence of a valid radio licence for the vessel.
5. Attach a copy of the vessel registration certificate.
6. All crew must hold valid STCW certificates of competency.
7. Submit the company HSE policy and incident statistics for the last 3 years.
8. Evidence of NIMASA cabotage registration is preferred.

Section 5 - Commercial
Bidders shall quote a day rate in NGN, inclusive of crew and lube oil.
